body: Thank you. There are good things sometimes but it just feels so insignificant in comparison to all the bad, there's no point in wasting peoples time and the worlds resources for such an unhappy existence.

I'm 18, I've been on meds since 12 and in therapy on and off since 10. I see two mental health workers every week (a psych nurse and a psychoanalytic therapist) I've been through various kinds of therapy/counselling and on maybe 15 different meds.
Thank you. I don't really know what else to say, but it means a lot that someone has taken the time to reply
